summary: EuroDry Ltd. filed a routine Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, along with XBRL tagging for vessel operations, freight forward agreements, interest rate swaps, related-party balances and financings with Alpha Bank and Credia Bank. No special-situation transaction is disclosed; the items are ordinary quarterly reporting and hedge/loan fair-value disclosures. The filing includes references to a subsequent Kamsarmax bulk carrier acquisition and ATM activity, but these are standard operating events rather than a categorized special situation. There is no deal, stake, premium or board recommendation to trade. Watch only routine shipping-sector earnings and fleet expansion updates.
